conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Bulldozer blade chained to load; ground shows initial displacement; motion direction implied but not yet executed.  
INTERACTION: Continuous forward thrust → chain transmits force → load drags, compacts soil.  
PERSISTENCE: Chain tension and blade contact sustain load attachment; ground deformation propagates under load.
